source: Luxembourg CTIE, 2020 RNPP most-used given names
geographicScope: Published 2020 RNPP list for Luxembourg; no narrower age or demographic coverage claimed. Surnames in this library use a separate GND authority sample.
licenseScope: This exact official dataset declares cc-zero and is published by the certified government CTIE organization. The resource checksum in the publisher metadata matches the downloaded CSV.
attribution: CTIE, Registre national des personnes physiques (RNPP), 2020. Independently selected by this library.
selection: Retain every published given-name string, with explicit M/F mapped to male/female. Preserve the publisher CSV order within each sex, described as descending popularity. No frequencies are provided; do not apply the GND five-record threshold to this list. Generation is uniform.
display: Decode Windows-1252 and normalize NFC. Preserve source spelling, case and accents.

rights.publisher: Centre des technologies de l'information de l'Etat
